title: Please see attached invoice

left.subject: Q3 vendor invoice
left.bodyHtml:
Hi Mara,

The approved vendor invoice is now in the Finance portal.

Where to view it?

Open the Finance portal (Procurement → Invoices). No files are sent by email.

right.subject: Invoice attached — action required
right.bodyHtml:
Hi,

Please review the attached invoice and confirm payment within 24 hours to avoid late fees.

Regards,
AP

explainPoints: Sender domain mismatch: nexatrust-pay.com is not your official domain.
Sent to personal mailbox instead of @nexatrust.com work email.
Asks to act on an email link and mentions an attachment—your policy is to use the Finance portal.
Creates false urgency (“24 hours”) to rush you.
